```json
 "rationale": "With vref=0.6 V, an NMOS pair has no tail headroom, so the inputs are matched-shifted to about 0.25 V into a PMOS pair. Shift error cancels because Ra=Rb+R1||R2. The pass is a 1:10 mirror, which keeps the gate low-Z and makes the gate pole track UGB, and makes gate VSG reject vin. Rz/Cz gives a high DC loop gain for load regulation and PSRR, a fast Rz path for the step response, and zero at 130 kHz. Iq is about 41 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "w_pass":     (1500.0, 800.0, 3000.0),   # pass PMOS width (L=0.15)
    "n_mirror":   (10.0, 6.0, 20.0),         # pass : diode ratio
    "w_m5":       (20.0, 8.0, 50.0),         # NMOS gate-driver width (L=0.15)
    "w_pair":     (30.0, 12.0, 80.0),        # PMOS input pair width (L=0.5)
    "tail_ratio": (4.0, 2.0, 6.0),           # tail = 4uA * ratio
    "rz":         (40e3, 15e3, 120e3),       # EA-output lag-lead resistor
    "cz":         (30e-12, 8e-12, 80e-12),   # EA-output lag-lead capacitor
    "rdiv":       (150e3, 60e3, 300e3),      # R1 = R2
    "cff":        (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 8e-12),   # divider / shift bypass caps
    "rshift":     (350e3, 220e3, 600e3),     # Ra (vref side); shift = 1uA*Ra
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref, cl = spec["vref"], spec["cl"]
    imin, imax = spec["iload_min"], spec["iload_max"]
    iref = 10e-6
    N = max(2, int(round(p["n_mirror"])))
    w_pass = p["w_pass"]; w6 = w_pass / N
    tr = p["tail_ratio"]; itail = 4e-6 * tr
    rdiv = p["rdiv"]; ra = p["rshift"]; rb = ra - rdiv / 2.0   # Thevenin-matched shift
    ishift = 1e-6
    cff = p["cff"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # ---- bias: IREF (10uA) into NMOS diode at ibias
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 20.0, 2.0)
    n.M("MSA", "a", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 2.0)        # 1uA shift sinks
    n.M("MSB", "b", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 2.0)
    n.M("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 8.0, 2.0)       # 4uA
    n.M("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 20.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MPT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", 20.0 * tr, 1.0)  # tail = 4u*tr
    # ---- level shift (down by ~0.35 V), matched on both inputs
    n.R("RA", "vref", "a", ra);  n.C("CA", "vref", "a", cff)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", rdiv); n.C("C1", "vout", "fb", cff)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", rdiv);  n.C("C2", "fb", "vss", cff)
    n.R("RB", "fb", "b", rb);      n.C("CB", "fb", "b", cff)
    # ---- error amp: PMOS pair (bulk = own source), NMOS mirror load
    n.M("M1", "d1", "a", "tail", "tail", "pfet", p["w_pair"], 0.5)
    n.M("M2", "x", "b", "tail", "tail", "pfet", p["w_pair"], 0.5)
    wl = 6.0 * itail / 16e-6
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wl, 1.0)
    n.M("M4", "x", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wl, 1.0)
    # ---- lag-lead at EA output
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xz", p["rz"]); n.C("CZ", "xz", "vss", p["cz"])
    # ---- gm stage + current-mirror pass
    n.M("M5", "g", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_m5"], 0.15)
    n.M("M6", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", w6, 0.15)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", w_pass, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions
    idiv = 2 * vref / (2 * rdiv)                 # vout/(2 rdiv)
    i6_min = (imin + idiv) / N
    iq = iref + idiv + itail + itail / tr + 2 * ishift + i6_min
    gm1 = 16.0 * itail / 2
    rx = 1.0 / (2 * 0.06 * itail / 2 * 1.0 + 1e-12) / 1.0   # ~ro2||ro4
    rx = min(rx, 5e6)
    a1 = gm1 * rx
    ahf = gm1 * p["rz"]
    beta = 0.5
    gp_lo = 16.0 * (imin + idiv); gp_hi = 9.0 * imax
    ro_lo = 1.0 / (imin / 0.8 + 1.0 / (2 * rdiv)); ro_hi = 0.8 / imax * 1.0
    # PSRR ~ loop gain at 1 kHz (diode keeps pass VSG tracking vin)
    def T1k(gp, ro):
        w = 2 * PI * 1e3
        zx = 1.0 / abs(1.0 / rx + 1.0 / (p["rz"] + 1.0 / (1j * w * p["cz"])))
        zo = 1.0 / abs(1.0 / ro + 1j * w * cl)
        return gm1 * zx * beta * gp * zo
    psrr = 20 * math.log10(1 + min(T1k(gp_lo, ro_lo), T1k(gp_hi, ro_hi)))
    dvx = 0.3                                    # M5 gate swing light->heavy
    load_reg = 2 * dvx / a1 / (imax - imin)
    line_reg = 1.0 / (1 + T1k(gp_lo, ro_lo)) * 1e3 * 0.5
    # undershoot: EA must steer ~dvx/(gm1*rz) at fb, plus ~100ns charge deficit
    under = min(0.3, 2 * dvx / max(ahf, 1) * 0.6 + 0.5 * imax * 30e-9 / cl)
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 0.3,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": under,
        "overshoot": 0.1,
        "ripple_settled": 0.001,
    }
```
